content.text: About Engines Market Save money and stress on engine replacement Engine failure is stressful enough. What makes it worse is not knowing how much a replacement should cost, who to trust, or whether you are getting a fair deal. Engines Market exists to change that. We give you a clear, free, and no-obligation way to compare real quotes from 100+ vetted UK engine specialists - all in one place. 100+ Vetted UK suppliers 24,650+ Quote requests in 2025 5.2 Days avg. from quote to fit COMPARE Engines Market Compare · Transparent · Free Our mission To make engine replacement pricing transparent across the UK. No hidden fees. No pressure. Just real data, real suppliers, and a clear path to a fair price. Transparent No pressure Real data What we do (and what we do not do) A comparison platform - nothing more, nothing less Engines Market is a price comparison platform . We connect you with independent UK engine suppliers. That is all. We do Help you compare quotes from vetted specialists Provide transparent pricing guidance Share marketplace data (e.g., 24,650+ quote requests) Introduce you to relevant suppliers We do NOT Sell engines ourselves Fit engines Provide warranties Handle payments Mediate disputes between customers and suppliers All contracts, warranties, and payments are directly between you and the supplier you choose. Our role is to give you the information and options you need to make a confident decision. The problem we solve Why engine replacement is harder than it should be Lack of price transparency Engine replacement costs vary wildly. Most drivers have no benchmark for a fair price. Stress of a major breakdown An engine failure is a big financial hit. Not knowing where to turn makes it worse. Fragmented marketplace Hundreds of specialists exist, but comparing them is difficult. You end up calling around, repeating your story, and still wondering if you got the best deal. How we solve it Four simple steps to a fair price Based on 24,650 quote requests processed in 2025 [EM-VERIFIED], most owners receive a competitive offer within 5.2 days from start to finish. 1 Submit your enquiry Enter your registration, mileage, and a short description. Takes a few minutes - completely free. 2 We match you Your anonymised enquiry is shared with relevant specialists from our network of 100+ UK suppliers. 3 Receive & compare You'll typically get 3-5 quotes within a few hours, direct from suppliers. 4 You choose No obligation. You decide which supplier to contact, ask questions, and proceed if you're happy. Start your free quote today → Get quotes Why UK drivers trust us Honesty is the foundation of trust We are transparent about our marketplace model, our data, and our limitations. We do not claim to be a garage or a warranty provider. We are a comparison platform - and we believe that honesty is the foundation of trust. Transparency Open about how we work, what we charge (nothing to you), and where we add value. Fairness We present all condition types with their real pros and cons. No steering unless the data supports it. Expertise Our guidance is based on real marketplace data, not guesswork. Simplicity One enquiry, multiple quotes, clear next steps. What our customers say Real stories from real UK drivers I was quoted £4,500 by a local garage. Through Engines Market I got three quotes - the best was £2,800 for a reconditioned engine with a 12-month warranty. Saved me nearly £2,000. James, Manchester - BMW 320d, N47 timing chain failure Simple, fast, no pressure. I had quotes within 4 hours and chose a supplier the same day. The whole process was exactly as described. Sarah, Bristol - Ford Focus 1.6 TDCi The warranty guide on their site helped me understand what to ask suppliers. I ended up choosing a reconditioned engine with labour cover - peace of mind for my daily driver. Mike, Birmingham - VW Passat 2.0 TDI We display a live Trustpilot widget on our homepage. Read hundreds more verified reviews here. Explore more about Engines Market Detailed guides and resources Here is where you can find detailed information about how we work, our supplier standards, and how to get in touch. ↗ How Engines Market works A step-by-step walkthrough of the process from enquiry to quote, including our legal disclaimer. ↗ Supplier standards How we vet the 100+ specialists in our network, and what we expect from them. ↗ Engine warranty guide Understand the different types of warranty, common exclusions, and questions to ask your supplier. ↗ Warranty claims guide What to do if you need to make a claim, and how we can help (without acting as a mediator). ↗ Contact us Reach our team for support, partnership enquiries, or just to ask a question. Frequently asked questions Quick answers about Engines Market What does Engines Market do- + Engines Market is a price comparison platform that connects you with independent UK engine suppliers. We help you compare quotes from vetted specialists to find a fair price for engine replacement. How does the engine replacement quote process work- + You submit your enquiry online. We match you with relevant specialists from our network of 100+ UK suppliers. You will typically receive 3-5 quotes within a few hours, then you choose the supplier that best fits your needs. Is Engines Market a garage or engine seller- + No. Engines Market is a comparison platform. We do not sell engines, fit engines, provide warranties, or handle payments. All contracts are directly between you and the supplier you choose. How much does it cost to use Engines Market- + It is completely free for drivers. We do not charge you anything to submit an enquiry or receive quotes. Our revenue comes from suppliers who pay a small fee to be part of our network. How do you vet your suppliers- + We vet suppliers based on their UK business registration, trading history, customer reviews, and adherence to our supplier standards. We regularly review supplier performance to maintain quality. Ready to get your quote- Stop guessing. Start comparing. Enter your registration and see real prices from UK specialists who are ready to help.
